name: SPD/Flat pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 383 g for the left/right PD-A530 SPD/Flat pedal pair, using the handbook’s explicit pair-weight row. Cleat and loose-accessory inclusion is not specified in the weight row. One face has an SPD binding and the other is a flat platform.
